# Magnetic

Magnetic is an all-in-one platform designed to help professional services firms manage projects, resources, and finances efficiently.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/magnetic/.

## Actions

- **Get Current Follow-ups** (read-only): Retrieve upcoming follow-ups assigned to the authenticated user.
- **Get Magnetic Task** (read-only): Retrieve a task by its id.
- **Get Magnetic User by ID** (read-only): Get a magnetic user's details by id.
- **Get Users** (read-only): Retrieve the list of all users in the authenticated user's company.
- **Search Client Contacts** (read-only): Search contacts by field or client id.
- **Search Magnetic Tasks** (read-only): Search tasks by a specified field and value.
- **Get Contact Tags** (read-only): Get all tags associated with a contact.
- **Get Grouping Custom Field Definitions** (read-only): Retrieve all custom field definitions for groupings.
- **Get Grouping Statuses** (read-only): Retrieve the list of statuses for signed groupings.
- **Get Grouping Tags** (read-only): Retrieve tags associated with any groupings owned by the company.
- **Get Magnetic Groupings** (read-only): Retrieve a list of groupings.
- **Get Magnetic Opportunity Statuses** (read-only): Retrieve opportunity statuses.
